coverage_cases.title: Aluminium mounting bracket — candidate vendor: Atlas Precision Machining
coverage_cases.requirement: CNC-machine the bracket from 6061-T6 aluminium to a tolerance of plus/minus 0.05 mm; the finished part is 120 mm long.
coverage_cases.capability: We are a CNC machining shop for 6061 and 6063 aluminium, holding plus/minus 0.02 mm, on parts up to 400 mm.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Required process (CNC machining), material (6061 aluminium) and size (120 mm) are all within the vendor's stated capability, and the vendor's plus/minus 0.02 mm is tighter than the required plus/minus 0.05 mm. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: ABS top cover — candidate vendor: BrightMould Plastics
coverage_cases.requirement: Injection-mould the top cover in ABS to plus/minus 0.10 mm; the part footprint is 180 x 120 mm.
coverage_cases.capability: Injection moulding of ABS and PC enclosures to plus/minus 0.05 mm; mould base up to 300 x 250 mm.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Process (injection moulding), material (ABS), tolerance (0.05 mm tighter than the required 0.10 mm) and size (180 x 120 within 300 x 250) are all within the stated capability. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Silicone non-slip base pad — candidate vendor: FlexiSil Moulding
coverage_cases.requirement: Mould the base pad in liquid silicone rubber (LSR), shore A40.
coverage_cases.capability: Liquid silicone rubber (LSR) injection moulding for pads, gaskets and seals, shore A20 to A60.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor injection-moulds LSR across shore A20-A60; the pad is LSR shore A40 — within the stated material and hardness range. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Zinc die-cast hinge body — candidate vendor: CastWorks Foundry
coverage_cases.requirement: Pressure die-cast the hinge body in zinc alloy (ZAMAK) to plus/minus 0.08 mm.
coverage_cases.capability: High-pressure die-casting of zinc alloy (ZAMAK) parts to plus/minus 0.05 mm, up to 200 g.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Process (zinc HPDC), material (ZAMAK) and tolerance (0.05 tighter than 0.08) all within the stated capability. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Aluminium base plate (large) — candidate vendor: WideCut CNC
coverage_cases.requirement: CNC-mill the base plate from 6061 aluminium, 260 mm long, to plus/minus 0.05 mm.
coverage_cases.capability: CNC milling of aluminium with a working envelope up to 500 x 400 mm and plus/minus 0.02 mm.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The 260 mm part sits inside the 500 x 400 mm envelope; aluminium milling at plus/minus 0.02 mm is tighter than required. A within-envelope part IS covered — the deliberate control for the size confounder. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: NorthBridge logo on the ABS cover — candidate vendor: MarkRight Decoration
coverage_cases.requirement: Pad-print a one-colour NorthBridge logo on the moulded ABS cover.
coverage_cases.capability: Secondary decoration: pad-printing, silk-screen and laser marking on plastic parts.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor explicitly offers pad-printing on plastics; the job is a one-colour pad-print on a plastic cover. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Powder-coated steel base — candidate vendor: DuraCoat Finishing
coverage_cases.requirement: Powder-coat the steel base matte black (RAL 9005).
coverage_cases.capability: Electrostatic powder coating in any RAL colour, plus wet spray; substrates: steel and aluminium.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Powder coating, on steel, in any RAL colour (so RAL 9005 included). COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Deburred machined zinc parts — candidate vendor: SurfacePro Finishing
coverage_cases.requirement: Tumble-deburr the machined zinc parts and break the sharp edges.
coverage_cases.capability: Complete mass-finishing line for metal parts: barrelling, drag finishing and shot peening.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Tumble-deburring and edge-breaking ARE mass-finishing operations; barrelling is the tumbling family and drag finishing rounds edges, so the vendor's mass-finishing line covers the required deburring even though it names different machines. COVERED — with no shared distinctive word.

coverage_cases.title: TPU corner bumper — candidate vendor: PolyAll Moulding
coverage_cases.requirement: Injection-mould the corner bumper in TPU.
coverage_cases.capability: Plastics moulder running all common thermoplastics and thermoplastic elastomers.
coverage_cases.reasoning: TPU is a thermoplastic elastomer; the vendor moulds all common thermoplastics and thermoplastic elastomers, so TPU falls within the stated material family. COVERED — no shared distinctive word.

coverage_cases.title: Retail carton and foam insert — candidate vendor: PackHaven Packaging
coverage_cases.requirement: Source the printed retail carton and the EPE foam insert.
coverage_cases.capability: Full protective-packaging supplier for consumer electronics.
coverage_cases.reasoning: A printed retail carton and a foam insert are protective packaging for an electronics product; a full protective-packaging supplier covers them. COVERED — no shared distinctive word.

coverage_cases.title: Precision aluminium bracket — candidate vendor: ExtrudaLite Aluminium
coverage_cases.requirement: CNC-machine the bracket from 6061-T6 aluminium to plus/minus 0.02 mm.
coverage_cases.capability: CNC machining of aluminium extrusions and profiles to plus/minus 0.1 mm, lengths up to 1.5 m.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor machines aluminium EXTRUSIONS and profiles (constant-section stock) and holds only plus/minus 0.1 mm; the bracket is a 3-D machined part needing plus/minus 0.02 mm. Different part form AND a tolerance five times looser than required. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'CNC'/'aluminium'.

coverage_cases.title: Polycarbonate optical light guide — candidate vendor: MouldenABS Plastics
coverage_cases.requirement: Injection-mould the light guide in optical-grade polycarbonate (PC).
coverage_cases.capability: Injection moulding of ABS and PP housings.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor moulds ABS and PP only; the part needs optical-grade polycarbonate (PC), a different material the vendor does not list. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Zinc die-cast hinge bracket — candidate vendor: AluCast HPDC
coverage_cases.requirement: Pressure die-cast the hinge bracket in zinc alloy.
coverage_cases.capability: Aluminium-alloy pressure die-casting (HPDC) for heat sinks and housings.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor pressure die-casts ALUMINIUM alloy; the part is ZINC alloy die-casting. Same broad process name, different metal — aluminium and zinc HPDC are distinct alloy processes with different tooling and machines. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'alloy'.

coverage_cases.title: Hard-anodised brackets — candidate vendor: AnoColor Anodising
coverage_cases.requirement: Anodise the brackets Type III (hard-coat), 50 micron.
coverage_cases.capability: Type II decorative anodising and colour dyeing.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor offers Type II (thin decorative) anodising; the part needs Type III hard-coat (a thick wear coating run on different chemistry and rectifiers). Type II does not cover Type III. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'Type'/'anodising'.

coverage_cases.title: Stainless spring contact — candidate vendor: StampLine Pressworks
coverage_cases.requirement: Stamp the spring contact from 0.3 mm stainless 301 spring steel.
coverage_cases.capability: Progressive-die metal stamping of cold-rolled mild steel up to 2 mm.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor stamps mild steel; the contact needs stainless 301 in spring temper — a different steel grade whose work-hardening and springback the vendor does not list. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'stamping'/'steel'.

coverage_cases.title: Aluminium heat sink (long) — candidate vendor: MicroMill CNC
coverage_cases.requirement: CNC-mill the aluminium heat sink, 220 mm long, fins 1.0 mm thick.
coverage_cases.capability: CNC milling of aluminium, maximum part envelope 150 x 150 x 80 mm.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The part is 220 mm long; the vendor's working envelope tops out at 150 mm. The part exceeds the stated size envelope, so it cannot be made on the vendor's machines. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'CNC'/'aluminium'.

coverage_cases.title: Precision silicone seal — candidate vendor: CompMould Rubber
coverage_cases.requirement: Mould the seal in liquid silicone rubber (LSR) to plus/minus 0.05 mm.
coverage_cases.capability: Compression moulding of HCR (solid) silicone rubber to plus/minus 0.20 mm.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor compression-moulds HCR (solid-gum) silicone at plus/minus 0.20 mm; the seal needs LSR (liquid) injection at plus/minus 0.05 mm — a different silicone form/process and a tolerance four times tighter than the vendor holds. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'silicone'.

coverage_cases.title: Aluminium T-slot rail — candidate vendor: CastMach Aluminium
coverage_cases.requirement: Extrude the aluminium T-slot rail, 1.2 m long.
coverage_cases.capability: Aluminium high-pressure die-casting and CNC machining.
coverage_cases.reasoning: A 1.2 m constant-section T-slot rail is an EXTRUSION; the vendor offers die-casting (net-shape casting) and machining (subtractive) but no extrusion line, so it cannot make a metres-long profile. The required process is outside the vendor's processes. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'aluminium'.

coverage_cases.title: Flame-retardant enclosure — candidate vendor: StdPlast Injection
coverage_cases.requirement: Mould the enclosure in flame-retardant ABS (UL94 V-0).
coverage_cases.capability: Injection moulding of general-purpose ABS and HIPS.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor moulds general-purpose (non-FR) ABS; the enclosure needs flame-retardant UL94 V-0 ABS, a different resin grade that general-purpose ABS does not meet. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'ABS'.

coverage_cases.title: Mild-steel chassis (formed) — candidate vendor: FlatCut Sheet Metal
coverage_cases.requirement: Laser-cut and press-brake bend the 1.5 mm mild-steel chassis.
coverage_cases.capability: Sheet-metal laser cutting and CNC punching of mild steel and aluminium up to 3 mm.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The chassis needs laser cutting AND press-brake bending (forming); the vendor cuts and punches flat sheet but lists no bending/forming press, so it cannot deliver the formed chassis. The forming step is outside the vendor's processes. NOT COVERED, despite sharing 'laser'/'mild'/'steel'.

coverage_cases.title: C360 brass threaded spacer — candidate vendor: YellowMetal Turnings
coverage_cases.requirement: CNC-turn the 18 mm standoff from C360 brass with an M3 internal thread.
coverage_cases.capability: Swiss turning of yellow-metal electrical hardware and miniature fasteners.
coverage_cases.reasoning: C360 brass is a yellow metal, and a threaded spacer is miniature electrical hardware / fastener work. The stated Swiss-turning capability covers the part. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Ceramic-coated aluminium face trim — candidate vendor: MicroArc Finishers
coverage_cases.requirement: Apply a plasma-electrolytic-oxidation ceramic coating to the aluminium face trim.
coverage_cases.capability: Micro-arc oxidation finishing for lightweight metal consumer parts.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Plasma electrolytic oxidation and micro-arc oxidation are the same coating family, and aluminium is a lightweight metal. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Phosphor-bronze battery spring clip — candidate vendor: CopperFlex Stampings
coverage_cases.requirement: Stamp the spring clip from 0.20 mm phosphor bronze and nickel-plate it.
coverage_cases.capability: Progressive stamping of beryllium copper and nickel-silver contact parts with tin plating.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The required alloy is phosphor bronze with nickel plating; the vendor lists different copper alloys and tin plating. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: 304 stainless cable tray weldment — candidate vendor: SpotSteel Fabrication
coverage_cases.requirement: Laser-weld the folded cable tray in 304 stainless steel.
coverage_cases.capability: Resistance spot welding of mild-steel brackets and clips.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Laser welding and resistance spot welding are different joining processes, and 304 stainless is not mild steel. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Moulded-pulp protective tray — candidate vendor: EcoTransit Packaging
coverage_cases.requirement: Produce a moulded-pulp tray that passes ISTA 2A parcel drop testing.
coverage_cases.capability: Transport-packaging design for electronics, including fibre cushions and ISTA validation.
coverage_cases.reasoning: A moulded-pulp tray is a fibre cushion, and ISTA validation covers the drop-test requirement. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Two-shot PC and TPU button — candidate vendor: ClearOne Moulding
coverage_cases.requirement: Two-shot mould the button with a clear PC window and a TPU grip overmould.
coverage_cases.capability: Single-shot injection moulding of clear PC display windows.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor offers only single-shot PC moulding; the part needs two-shot moulding plus a TPU overmould. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Heat-staked brass inserts — candidate vendor: InsertPro Assembly
coverage_cases.requirement: Heat-stake M2 brass threaded inserts into ABS bosses.
coverage_cases.capability: Thermal insertion and ultrasonic staking of threaded inserts into thermoplastic housings.
coverage_cases.reasoning: ABS is a thermoplastic housing material, and heat staking is a thermal insertion method for threaded inserts. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Zinc-nickel plated spring clip — candidate vendor: BrightZinc Plating
coverage_cases.requirement: Plate the steel spring clip with zinc-nickel alloy to Class 2A, 8 micron.
coverage_cases.capability: Decorative bright zinc plating on steel hardware.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Bright zinc plating is not zinc-nickel alloy plating to the specified Class 2A coating. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Graphite heat-spreader laminate — candidate vendor: ThermalConvert Ltd.
coverage_cases.requirement: Die-cut a graphite heat-spreader sheet laminated with pressure-sensitive adhesive.
coverage_cases.capability: Converting of thermal interface materials, graphite films and adhesive laminates.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor converts graphite thermal films and adhesive laminates, exactly the heat-spreader laminate. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Polyimide FPC jumper — candidate vendor: RigidBoard PCB
coverage_cases.requirement: Build a polyimide flexible printed circuit with 0.075 mm trace and space.
coverage_cases.capability: Rigid FR-4 PCB fabrication with 0.15 mm trace and space.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Polyimide FPC and rigid FR-4 PCB are different constructions, and 0.15 mm capability is looser than the required 0.075 mm trace/space. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Serialized QR laser mark — candidate vendor: TraceMark Laser
coverage_cases.requirement: Laser-etch serialized QR codes on anodized aluminium trim.
coverage_cases.capability: Fiber and UV laser marking on metals and plastics, including QR serialization.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The vendor offers laser marking on metals with QR serialization; anodized aluminium trim is a metal part. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Optical PC light-pipe polishing — candidate vendor: HousingMould Standard
coverage_cases.requirement: Injection-mould the clear optical-grade PC light pipe and diamond-polish the gate face.
coverage_cases.capability: Injection moulding of opaque ABS and PP housings with standard tumble finishing.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The material is opaque ABS/PP rather than optical PC, and tumble finishing is not diamond polishing for an optical face. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: E-marker USB-C cable assembly — candidate vendor: CrimpWire Harness
coverage_cases.requirement: Assemble a USB-C cable with an e-marker PCB and 5 A rating.
coverage_cases.capability: Crimped wire harnesses and barrel-plug cable assemblies.
coverage_cases.reasoning: The requirement is a USB-C assembly with e-marker electronics and 5 A rating; generic crimped harness/barrel-plug assembly does not state that electronics/spec capability. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: 17-4PH stainless MIM latch pawl — candidate vendor: MicroMIM Components
coverage_cases.requirement: Metal-injection-mould the latch pawl in 17-4PH stainless steel; finished mass 4 g.
coverage_cases.capability: Metal injection moulding of 17-4PH stainless precision parts from 0.5 g to 20 g.
coverage_cases.reasoning: MIM process, 17-4PH stainless material and 4 g mass all sit inside the stated capability. COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: 17-4PH stainless latch casting — candidate vendor: FineCast Foundry
coverage_cases.requirement: Metal-injection-mould the latch pawl in 17-4PH stainless steel; finished mass 4 g.
coverage_cases.capability: Investment casting of stainless hardware, minimum casting weight 50 g.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Investment casting is not metal injection moulding, and the vendor's minimum casting weight is far above the 4 g part. NOT COVERED.

coverage_cases.title: Conductive fabric EMI gasket — candidate vendor: FoamDie Converting
coverage_cases.requirement: Die-cut nickel-plated conductive-fabric-over-foam EMI gaskets.
coverage_cases.capability: Die cutting of silicone foam pads and neoprene rubber seals.
coverage_cases.reasoning: Silicone/neoprene foam pads are not nickel-plated conductive fabric over foam for EMI gaskets. NOT COVERED.
